headline: Brazilian Treasury bond yields jump post-election as market volatility spikes
summary: Yields on Brazilian fixed-rate government debt (Tesouro Prefixado) experienced sharp upward spikes following election results, producing capital losses for short-term bondholders.
why: Brazilian local interest rates react quickly to political developments and fiscal policy outlooks, directly impacting local debt portfolios.

impacts.name: Brazil 10-year yield
impacts.why: Post-election uncertainty and market position adjustments drove local bond yields higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Post-election portfolio rebalancing and fiscal policy concerns pushed Brazilian sovereign bond yields significantly higher.
